tetra.improvement.mana_repair.name: Mana Repair

tetra.stats.manaRepair.tooltip: This item repairs itself over time using mana, consuming §e%s§r mana per point of durability restored
tetra.material.feature.rootboon.tooltip:
The primary module crafted from Ironwood gains an enchantment based on its module type
 
§7As long as the enchantment does not conflict with enchantments already on the item
tetra.material.feature.rootboon.tooltip_:
Enchantments are applied based on the following conditions:
 §7- Blunt/edged weapons and breakers: §eFortune I
 §7- Breakers: §eEfficiency I
 §7- Breakable: §eUnbreaking I
tetra.material.feature.leafboon.tooltip:
The primary module crafted from Steeleaf gains an enchantment based on its module type
 
§7As long as the enchantment does not conflict with enchantments already on the item
tetra.material.feature.leafboon.tooltip_:
Enchantments are applied based on the following conditions:
 §7- Blunt/edged weapons and breakers: §eEfficiency II
 §7- Breakers: §eFortune II
 §7- Blunt/edged weapons: §eLooting II
tetra.material.feature.fiery_igniting.to: The primary module crafted from Fiery Ingot gains the §eIgniting§r or §eBlazing§r modifier based on its module slot

Grip modules such as handles, hafts, or bowstrings gain the §eBlazing§7 modifier.
Modules typically used to strike targets, such as blades or tool heads, gain the §eIgniting§7 modifier.
When a Fiery Ingot is used as the material for a primary module with the §lBreaker§r trait, the §eAuto-Smelt§r modifier is applied
tetra.improvement.fiery_igniting.name: Igniting
tetra.improvement.fiery_igniting.descrip: Sets entities on fire when struck

tetra.improvement.fiery_blazing.name: Blazing
tetra.improvement.fiery_blazing.descript: Using this item has a chance to set the user on fire

tetra.stats.autoSmelt.tooltip: Automatically smelts drops when breaking blocks
tetra/schematic/shared/fiery_bond.name: Fiery Bond
tetra/schematic/shared/fiery_bond.descri: Infuse the handle with fiery essence from a Hydra or Ur-Ghast to gain a method of countering or exploiting burning effects, depending on which essence is used.
tetra.improvement.hydral_bond.name: Hydra Bond
tetra.improvement.hydral_bond.descriptio: Restores durability when the user takes damage
Strengthen the bond to enhance its effect.
tetra.stats.hydralBond.tooltip: Taking fire damage while holding this item has a §e%s%%§r chance to repair §e%s§r durability
tetra.improvement.quenched.name: Quenched
tetra.improvement.quenched.description: Greatly reduces the chance of triggering the Blazing effect
tetra/schematic/shared/hone_quenched.des: Strengthen the bond to increase its effect.
tetra.material.feature.darkwrought.toolt: Blades and tool heads crafted from Knightmetal gain the §eSkewering§r or §ePunishing§r modifier based on their module type
Modules classified as §lEdged weapons§r and §lBreakers§r gain §eSkewering§r; all other modules gain §ePunishing§r. Butts are unaffected.
Deals increased damage to unarmored targets
Deals increased damage to armored targets
tetra.stats.punishing.tooltip: Deals up to §e%s§r bonus damage to armored targets, scaling with the amount of armor the target is wearing
tetra.stats.punishing.tooltip_extended: The bonus damage is reduced by the percentage of empty armor slots on the target. For example, against a target with 1 empty slot out of 4, 75%% of the bonus damage is applied. For targets with innate armor that wear no armor pieces, the full bonus damage is applied.
tetra.module.double/minotaur_axe.name: Minotaur Axe
tetra.module.double/minotaur_axe.descrip: A heavy axe favored by minotaurs. Deals bonus damage when the user is sprinting at the moment of the attack.
tetra.stats.charging.tooltip: Attacking while sprinting deals §e%s§r bonus damage
tetra/schematic/sword/twilight_focus.des:
Craft a focus from one of the scepters found in the Twilight Forest.
The focus grants different on-hit or on-kill effects depending on the scepter used. The focus effect typically damages the item when triggered.
tetra.module.sword/twilight_focus.name: Twilight Focus
tetra.module.sword/twilight_focus.descri: A focus crafted from a scepter found in the Twilight Forest.
tetra.variant.twilight_focus/reanimating: A focus crafted from a Zombie Scepter. Mobs killed with this weapon are reanimated under the user's control.
A focus crafted from a Scepter of Defense. Killing a mob fortifies the user.
tetra.variant.twilight_focus/sapping.des: A focus crafted from a Life-Draining Scepter. Striking mobs drains their health and hunger, restoring the user's health and saturation.
tetra.variant.twilight_focus/blasting.de: A focus crafted from a Twilight Scepter. Swinging this weapon in the air fires a twilight bolt.
tetra.stats.fortifying.tooltip:
Killing a mob grants the user a barrier that absorbs the next instance of incoming damage.
The barrier can stack up to §e4§r times; each blocked hit removes one stack. Stacks last §e12§r seconds, and killing a mob refreshes the duration. When the effect triggers, the item takes §e%s§r durability damage.
tetra.stats.reanimating.tooltip:
Killing a mob reanimates it under the user's control. The reanimated mob begins fading after §e%s§r seconds.
Killing undead mobs (such as zombies or skeletons) does not trigger this effect. When the effect triggers, the item takes §e%s%%§r durability damage.
tetra.stats.sapping.tooltip: Striking a mob restores §e%s§r health and §e%s§r saturation to the user. When the effect triggers, the item takes §e%s%%§r durability damage.
tetra.stats.twilightBolt.tooltip:
Fires a twilight bolt when swung in the air; the bolt deals §e6§r damage to the first mob it hits.
Triggering this effect deals §e%s%%§r durability damage to the item and puts it on a §e400%%§r (§e%s§r second) cooldown.
